assessment.nobel_worthiness: A kilometre-scale neutrino telescope opened an observational window on cosmic particle accelerators. This is an exceptionally clear match to instrument-driven discovery with lasting fundamental reach.
assessment.attribution: Halzen's conception and sustained leadership provide a plausible decisive contribution. A one-person configuration requires an especially careful account of the detector and analysis teams' essential work.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical flux is established through accumulating observations and complementary event selections; recognition of the window is more mature than recognition of any single source.
uncertainties: The packet supplies no allocation of detector, calibration and discovery-analysis credit within IceCube.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: ATLAS and CMS converted a fundamental prediction into a reproducible experimental discovery. Their detector architectures are a profound achievement in measuring rare processes against large backgrounds.
assessment.attribution: Jenni's ATLAS and Della Negra and Virdee's CMS contributions support a detector-centered configuration. The proposed trio must be justified by their concrete design and construction responsibilities.
assessment.maturity: Two independently designed experiments and extensive subsequent measurements make the discovery exceptionally mature.
uncertainties: A prize for detector invention must distinguish these contributions from discovery-era management and the work of large collaborations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The magnetar interpretation connected unusual high-energy transients to an extreme magnetic-energy reservoir. Its quantitative theoretical and observational connection makes it a durable astrophysical discovery.
assessment.attribution: Duncan and Thompson supply the defining physical model, while Kouveliotou represents the decisive observational establishment. This is a coherent theory-and-measurement configuration.
assessment.maturity: The interpretation has survived decades of timing and high-energy observations across multiple objects, rather than resting on one transient.
uncertainties: Detailed division of theoretical priority and which observations were uniquely decisive need specialist documentation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magic-wavelength optical lattice timekeeping created a new scale of precision measurement with applications to gravity and fundamental constants. The invention matters beyond improvements to an existing clock.
assessment.attribution: Katori's trapping concept and Ye's realization of extreme performance offer complementary decisive contributions. The two-person configuration avoids conflating this invention with every enabling laser technology.
assessment.maturity: Multiple laboratories operate these clocks and characterize their systematics; the measurement platform is mature.
uncertainties: The packet lacks a priority dossier separating the original lattice concept from subsequent performance and other laboratories' advances.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Baryon acoustic oscillations made the large-scale matter distribution into a calibrated geometric ruler. A predicted physical signature that became a robust cosmological measurement deserves serious recognition.
assessment.attribution: Sunyaev links the acoustic prediction to Eisenstein's and Cole's survey detections. This theory-and-independent-observation configuration is defensible but omits another supplied survey contributor.
assessment.maturity: Repeated surveys and independent analysis methods establish the ruler's value; its recognition need not depend on claims about evolving dark energy.
uncertainties: Will J. Percival's decisive role and the allocation of credit within the survey teams require comparison before settling the three-person limit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry turned matter-wave phase into a practical measurement of acceleration and fundamental quantities. A new instrument principle with reproducible reach across physics fits a strong prize case.
assessment.attribution: Bordé's interferometric framework, Pritchard's material-grating realization and Kasevich's light-pulse implementation form a plausible complementary trio.
assessment.maturity: Its operation and systematic limitations have been explored over decades in independent precision experiments.
uncertainties: The packet does not establish the boundary between these contributions and earlier atom-interferometer or laser-manipulation work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A new classification of insulating matter was tied to measurable protected edge transport. The conceptual change and direct experimental test make a clear discovery rather than a broad materials programme.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele's defining theory and Molenkamp's quantum spin Hall realization form a compact configuration.
assessment.maturity: The central phase and its transport signatures are mature and have supported an enduring field.
uncertainties: A specialist review should assess the indispensable role of the material-specific prediction and limits of experimental edge-transport interpretation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reactor disappearance established an essential neutrino-mixing parameter and enabled a new precision programme. Its clean comparison of near and far measurements is experimentally persuasive.
assessment.attribution: Luk and Wang plausibly represent the Daya Bay effort and Kim the independent RENO effort. The discovery rests on collaborations, so named leadership alone is insufficient proof of decisive personal credit.
assessment.maturity: Independent reactor experiments and subsequent precision measurements make the nonzero mixing result secure.
uncertainties: The packet contains no contribution-level account of these individuals or other independent reactor teams; the advance must be distinguished from the already recognized discovery of neutrino oscillations.
